Description: Check reset defaults (0x0) and read/write access to DMA registers (CTRL, STATUS, SRC_ADDR, DST_ADDR, LENGTH).
C Part: Writes base addresses and lengths; reads back registers to verify setup.
SV Part: Issues AXI-Lite read/write cycles; checks register flip-flops and OKAY responses.

Description: Check 16-byte (4-word) memory-to-memory copy between DMEM source and destination.
C Part: Sets DMA_SRC_ADDR, DMA_DST_ADDR, DMA_LENGTH=16, triggers START, and polls STATUS.
SV Part: Monitors DMA master read/write bursts on internal bus; checks destination equals source byte-for-byte.
Internal or External: Internal (On-chip DMEM & internal AXI master bus)

Description: Check 256-byte bulk transfer of 16x16 INT8 image from DMEM to CNN SRAM buffer (0x2000_3100).
C Part: Sets SRC=&test_image, DST=0x20003100, LENGTH=256, START=1; verifies completion status.
SV Part: Monitors burst writes; verifies all 256 bytes are loaded into CNN SRAM buffer without stall.
Internal or External: Internal (On-chip DMEM to on-chip CNN SRAM buffer)

Description: Check transfer of 13 bytes (3 full 32-bit words + 1 byte) with byte strobes.
C Part: Configures DMA_LENGTH=13; checks destination buffer after completion.
SV Part: Asserts words 0-2 write with wstrb=4'hF and word 3 with wstrb=4'h1; checks other bytes untouched.

Description: Check that dedicated interrupt pin dma_irq_o pulses high when transfer completes.
C Part: Enables interrupt bit in CTRL (IRQ_EN=1); services interrupt or waits for completion flag.
SV Part: Monitors physical dma_irq_o pin on chip boundary; checks pin rises from 0 to 1 upon completion.

Description: Check Write-1-to-Clear (W1C) clears status flags and drops dma_irq_o back to 0.
C Part: Writes '1' to STATUS.DONE bit after transfer completes to acknowledge interrupt.
SV Part: Probes dma_irq_o pin and STATUS register; verifies pin drops from 1 to 0 immediately on W1C write.

Description: Fault injection: Program unaligned source address (0x1000_0003) and verify error latching.
C Part: Configures unaligned address; checks STATUS register for error code.
SV Part: Verifies DMA FSM latches STATUS.ERROR=1 with ERROR_CODE=1 and blocks bus master requests.

Description: Fault injection: Program LENGTH=0 and verify transfer rejection.
C Part: Configures LENGTH=0, START=1; reads back error status.
SV Part: Verifies DMA aborts transfer without issuing bus transactions; asserts ERROR_CODE=1.

Description: Fault injection: Write START=1 while DMA is already busy running a transfer.
C Part: Writes START=1 twice consecutively without waiting for completion.
SV Part: Verifies ongoing transfer finishes safely; second command is dropped with ERROR_CODE=4.

Description: Check soft reset recovery during an active bulk transfer.
C Part: Sets CTRL.SOFT_RESET=1 while transfer is running.
SV Part: Verifies FSM immediately halts, cancels master requests, and resets internal counters to IDLE.

Description: Check 8-bit signed multiplication and 32-bit accumulation datapath with synchronous clear.
C Part: N/A (Submodule hardware testbench).
SV Part: Drives signed INT8 pixel and weight inputs; checks product accumulation and clear_acc reset.

Description: Check 3x3 2D convolution on 16x16 image with 4 parallel filters (produces 784 activations).
C Part: N/A (Submodule hardware testbench).
SV Part: Feeds test image and filter weights; compares all 784 output features against Python golden model.
Internal or External: Internal (On-chip sliding window buffers & MAC array)

Description: Check element-wise Rectified Linear Unit activation (clamping negative numbers to 0).
C Part: N/A (Submodule hardware testbench).
SV Part: Drives signed positive and negative values; verifies negative values clamp to 0 and positive values pass.

Description: Check 2x2 max pooling with stride 2 across 784 inputs (reduces to 196 features).
C Part: N/A (Submodule hardware testbench).
SV Part: Applies 14x14 feature maps per filter; verifies non-overlapping 2x2 max selection into 196 outputs.

Description: Check Fully Connected matrix multiplication (196 inputs x 16 neurons) with bias addition.
C Part: N/A (Submodule hardware testbench).
SV Part: Applies 196 features and 16x196 weights; checks that output 16-D embedding matches golden dot products.

Description: Check direct AXI writes and reads to the CNN 256-byte image SRAM buffer (0x2000_3100 - 0x2000_31FC).
C Part: Writes known pixel array into buffer address 0x2000_3100; reads back data to verify SRAM integrity.
SV Part: Monitors AXI writes to buffer range; checks SRAM memory array contents match written pixels.

Description: Check complete CNN inference trigger, busy polling, and 16-element embedding vector generation.
C Part: Sets DIM_CFG=16x16, EMBED_LEN=16, triggers START=1, polls STATUS.DONE, and reads embedding registers (0x20-0x5C).
SV Part: Monitors CNN AXI slave transactions; verifies pipeline execution cycles; checks embedding values are non-zero.

Description: Check assertion of dedicated completion interrupt pin cnn_irq_o when inference finishes.
C Part: Configures CNN_CTRL with IRQ_EN=1; waits for hardware completion.
SV Part: Probes physical cnn_irq_o output pin; checks pin asserts high when STATUS.DONE=1.

Description: Fault injection: Program invalid image dimensions or embedding length and check error handling.
C Part: Writes illegal dimension value to DIM_CFG; reads STATUS register.
SV Part: Verifies CNN detects illegal configuration, asserts STATUS.ERROR=1 with ERROR_CODE=3, and aborts start.

Description: Check hardware calculation of Manhattan (L1) distance: sum(|query[i] - ref[i]|) for 16 elements.
C Part: Loads query and reference vectors into IP slots; triggers calculation.
SV Part: Compares hardware computed distance in MIN_DISTANCE register against software reference calculation.

Description: Check classification when distance <= threshold (Expected: RESULT=1 for MATCH / NORMAL).
C Part: Sets matching reference vector, sets threshold=50, starts engine, verifies RESULT==1 and MIN_DISTANCE==0.
SV Part: Monitors Distance AXI registers; checks comparator asserts RESULT=1 when distance <= threshold.

Description: Check classification when distance > threshold (Expected: RESULT=0 for ANOMALY).
C Part: Sets divergent reference vector, sets threshold=50, starts engine, verifies RESULT==0 and MIN_DISTANCE==800.
SV Part: Monitors Distance AXI registers; checks comparator asserts RESULT=0 when distance > threshold.

Description: Check assertion of dedicated completion interrupt pin dist_irq_o when distance scoring finishes.
C Part: Configures DIST_CTRL with IRQ_EN=1; triggers scoring; clears interrupt via W1C.
SV Part: Probes physical dist_irq_o output pin; verifies pin rises to 1 on completion and drops to 0 on W1C.

Description: Fault injection: Program unsupported metric index into DIST_METRIC and verify error response.
C Part: Writes unsupported metric code (e.g. 5) into DIST_METRIC register.
SV Part: Verifies IP rejects configuration, asserts STATUS.ERROR=1 with ERROR_CODE=4, and refuses execution.

Description: Check programming of UART baud rate divisor latch (divisor = 16) and line control register (8N1).
C Part: Writes LCR=0x80 (DLAB enable), writes BAUD_DIV=16, restores LCR=0x03 (8 data bits, 1 stop bit, no parity).
SV Part: Monitors internal AXI writes to UART registers 0x2000_0008 and 0x2000_000C; verifies divisor latch value.

Description: Check physical serial transmission of ASCII characters over uart_tx_o pin at exact baud timing.
C Part: Calls uart_putc() / uart_puts() to transmit string messages to console.
SV Part: Probes physical uart_tx_o output wire; deserializes start bit, 8 data bits, and stop bit at 170 ns/bit; validates text.

Description: Check UART Line Status Register (LSR) transmitter holding register empty (THRE) and transmitter empty (TEMT).
C Part: Polls LSR register until THRE bit is 1 before writing next character into THR.
SV Part: Monitors AXI reads to LSR (0x2000_0014); checks THRE drops to 0 when FIFO is written and returns to 1 when empty.

Description: Check assertion of uart_irq_o pin when TX FIFO is empty or RX data is received.
C Part: Enables UART interrupts via IER register; handles interrupt or polls status.
SV Part: Probes physical uart_irq_o output pin; checks pin asserts upon configured UART trigger condition.

Description: Check continuous 64-bit real-time counter (MTIME) incrementation based on system clock.
C Part: Reads MTIME counter registers twice and verifies time progression.
SV Part: Monitors internal 64-bit timer counter registers; verifies increment rate matches prescaler setting.

Description: Check assertion of timer_irq_o pin when MTIME counter reaches comparator value (MTIME >= MTIMECMP).
C Part: Programs MTIMECMP = MTIME + 100; enables timer interrupt; waits for interrupt.
SV Part: Probes physical timer_irq_o output pin; verifies pin rises to 1 exactly when counter matches compare register.

Description: Check 32-bit pin direction configuration via GPIO_EN register (input vs push-pull output).
C Part: Writes direction mask to GPIO_EN (0x2000_2080); verifies output enables.
SV Part: Probes internal direction control bus gpio_dir_o[31:0]; checks pins configure correctly as inputs or outputs.

Description: Check driving arbitrary test patterns and stage indicators onto physical gpio_o[31:0] pins.
C Part: Writes progress status to GPIO_OUT: 0x01 (boot), 0x02 (DMA done), 0x04 (CNN done), 0x55 (all pass).
SV Part: Probes physical gpio_o[31:0] output pins on chip boundary; asserts pin levels match written values.

Description: Check atomic bit manipulation registers: GPIO_SET (0x200), GPIO_CLEAR (0x280), and GPIO_TOGGLE (0x300).
C Part: Writes single bitmasks to SET, CLEAR, and TOGGLE registers without read-modify-write software overhead.
SV Part: Monitors AXI writes to atomic offsets; asserts that target bits on gpio_o update while other bits remain unchanged.
Internal or External: External (Directly changes physical gpio_o output pins)

Description: Check external signal sampling on physical gpio_i[31:0] pins through 2-stage flip-flop synchronizer.
C Part: Reads GPIO_IN register (0x2000_2000) to inspect external switch/pin states.
SV Part: Drives asynchronous digital signals onto physical gpio_i pins; checks 2-stage synchronizer removes metastability.

Description: Check generation of gpio_irq_o pin on configurable rising-edge, falling-edge, or level triggers on input pins.
C Part: Enables GPIO interrupt mask; reads interrupt status; clears interrupt via W1C.
SV Part: Drives pulse transitions on gpio_i; probes physical gpio_irq_o pin; verifies interrupt asserts and clears cleanly.
Internal or External: External (Physical gpio_i pin transition -> gpio_irq_o pin)

Description: Check address decoding and routing from CPU master (S00) to all 8 slave peripheral targets (M00-M07).
C Part: Issues read/write accesses to all 8 base addresses: IMEM, DMEM, UART, Timer, GPIO, CNN, Distance, and DMA.
SV Part: Monitors select lines and handshakes on all 8 slave interfaces (m00_axi through m07_axi); verifies 1-to-1 routing.

Description: Check generation of DECERR (2'b11) response when accessing unmapped address space (e.g. 0x3000_0000).
C Part: Attempts read or write access to unmapped memory address.
SV Part: Captures write response bresp and read response rresp; asserts interconnect returns 2'b11 without bus hang.
Internal or External: Internal (On-chip crossbar default error slave logic)

Description: Check round-robin bus arbitration when CPU (S00) and DMA (S01) issue concurrent accesses to shared DMEM (M01).
C Part: Initiates DMA background transfer to DMEM while CPU actively reads instructions and data.
SV Part: Monitors simultaneous request lines; verifies round-robin arbiter grants alternating access without starving either master.
Internal or External: Internal (On-chip crossbar arbiter logic & grant handshakes)

Description: Check valid/ready flow control and stall handling across all AXI channels during burst transactions.
C Part: Issues continuous back-to-back memory and register transfers.
SV Part: Randomly asserts/deasserts ready signals; verifies master correctly holds valid and data until ready is high.

Description: Check Instruction Memory dual-port operation: CPU IFU instruction fetches and LSU/DMA data reads/writes.
C Part: Executes code from IMEM while testbench preloads hex data.
SV Part: Verifies simultaneous IFU fetch and AXI slave access to IMEM (0x0000_0000 - 0x0000_FFFF) without conflict.

Description: Check Data Memory byte-level access using 4-bit write strobes (wstrb) for 8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit accesses.
C Part: Performs uint8_t, uint16_t, and uint32_t stores and loads in DMEM (0x1000_0000 - 0x1000_FFFF).
SV Part: Checks that only enabled byte lanes in memory are modified; non-targeted bytes remain preserved.
Internal or External: Internal (On-chip 64 KB SRAM byte-enable mask logic)

Description: Check VeeR-EL2 CPU boot from hardware reset, instruction fetch from 0x0000_0000, and stack initialization.
C Part: crt0.s initializes stack pointer sp to 0x1000_FFF0, configures MRAC CSR (0x5555556A), and calls main().
SV Part: Deasserts rst_l; tracks CPU program counter (ifu_i0_pc); verifies execution starts at 0x0000_0000.
Internal or External: Internal (CPU reset vector logic & pipeline registers)

Description: Check CPU firmware execution logs system progress, embeddings, and results via UART serial output.
C Part: Firmware executes print routines outputting 26 structured log lines to the console.
SV Part: UART monitor captures all characters from physical uart_tx_o pin; verifies 26 complete lines and pass string.

Description: Check full autonomous pipeline classifying a normal image sample: DMA copy -> CNN inference -> Distance Match.
C Part: Orchestrates DMA transfer, CNN start, loads matching reference embedding, validates RESULT==1, logs PASS.
SV Part: Scoreboard captures DMA transfer, validates CNN embedding vector, and verifies Distance IP outputs Match=1.

Description: Check full autonomous pipeline classifying an anomaly image: DMA copy -> CNN inference -> Distance Anomaly.
C Part: Loads divergent reference embedding, triggers Distance IP, validates RESULT==0 (ANOMALY), logs PASS.
SV Part: Scoreboard verifies Distance IP outputs Dist=800, Result=0, and flags anomaly detection.

Description: Check system completion handshake via DMEM mailbox (0x1000_FF00) and final GPIO output pin state (0x00000055).
C Part: Writes 0xCAFE0001 to MAILBOX_REG (0x1000_FF00); drives GPIO_OUT = 0x00000055; enters sleep.
SV Part: Testbench samples physical gpio_o pins for 0x00000055 and checks DMEM mailbox holds 0xCAFE0001 before exiting.
Internal or External: External (Drives physical gpio_o pins & internal mailbox)
